sources.title: SmolLM3 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SmolLM3 is a fully open, compact language model designed for efficient deployment while maintaining strong performance. It uses a Transformer decoder architecture with Grouped Query Attention (GQA) to reduce the kv cache, and no RoPE, enabling improved performance on long-context tasks.

sources.title: SmolLM3-3B - atomic.chat
sources.snippet: SmolLM3-3B is a 3-billion-parameter decoder-only language model released by Hugging Face in 2025. It is an instruction-tuned model with dual-mode reasoning, native support for six languages, and context handling up to 128K tokens.
